metadata.description: Agent plugins for OpenCode, Claude Code, OMP and pi.

plugins.name: agent-reviewer

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture skills: capability-first top-level layout, ownership boundaries, and durable docs/ project knowledge.

plugins.name: ast-grep
plugins.description: Structural code search with the ast-grep CLI, plus when to use Semgrep or rust-analyzer instead.

plugins.name: aws
plugins.description: AWS working guidance: route AWS tasks through the AWS MCP Server's guided skills, verify against AWS documentation, and price with the AWS Pricing MCP server.

plugins.name: beads
plugins.description: Beads issue tracking: bd prime session context, shell gates on bd, git and gh commands, store pinning and the Beads skills.

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: Refuse edits and shell writes to chezmoi-managed live files, naming the source to edit, plus the chezmoi-editor skill.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Stress-test a decision from both sides or grill a plan in frontier rounds.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: UI and UX design skills: design-system audit, DESIGN.md, rendered-surface review, accessibility audit, motion, microcopy, prototypes, and wireframes.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic at five depth levels, from metaphor to frontier.

plugins.name: journeys
plugins.description: Author, validate and maintain user journeys: seven skills, the journeys.py helper, and the journey-scribe and journey-validator subagents.

plugins.name: lang-go
plugins.description: Go skills: build, lint, go test -race, tidy and govulncheck checks, testing and fuzzing, module and package layout, and pprof profiling.

plugins.name: lang-python
plugins.description: Python skills: uv, ruff, mypy or pyright and pytest checks, testing, packaging, typing and pydantic, SQLAlchemy and Alembic, and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-rust
plugins.description: Rust skills: fmt, clippy and test checks, testing with nextest, proptest and insta, crates and workspaces, CI, sqlx persistence, Tauri and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript skills: install, lint, tsc and test checks, testing, monorepo packaging, type safety and zod, and Bun and Node profiling.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle: scaffold a project with /new-project and pick an OSI-approved license.

plugins.name: project-secrets
plugins.description: Per-project secrets with fnox and 1Password: store, use, inspect and rotate them with no value in the transcript.

plugins.name: quality
plugins.description: Code design and review guidance, a code-quality policy, testing standards and a test audit, performance profiling, and throwaway logic prototypes.

plugins.name: repomix
plugins.description: Pack a local or remote repo into one file with repomix for bulk context: external repos, module packs and version diffs.

plugins.name: speckit-beads
plugins.description: SpecKit on Beads: a tasks.md guard, setup, ledger and bugfix skills, formulas, and the speckit-sync and speckit-verify subagents.

plugins.name: toolchain
plugins.description: Toolchain defaults as skills: stack, frontend, infrastructure, languages, observability, shell, Terraform, caches, background jobs and worktree coexistence.

plugins.name: trunk-dev
plugins.description: Trunk-based delivery for OpenCode, Claude Code, and pi: Conventional Commit and main-push gates, skip-CI and MR/PR advisories, feature-flag cleanup beads, and release-setup skills.

plugins.name: worktrunk
plugins.description: Worktrunk (wt) skills: work in linked worktrees and run deterministic preflight checks before an agent run or merge.
